text:
matt: Quick sync — we keep seeing streaming connections spike and consume the shared burst budget, which then throttles rerank/embeddings calls. Can we sketch a proposal for endpoint-specific burst buckets + a shared overflow reserve? Need: enforcement logic, metrics to track, console UX for overrides, and a safe rollout path.

sophia: +1. today we have a single token-bucket per API key with type-weighting. It's simple but opaque. Splitting per endpoint sounds sensible. Questions: do we allocate fixed quotas per endpoint or dynamic weights? also streaming is connection-count, not tokens, so model slightly different.

arya: my take: hybrid approach — per-endpoint token buckets for chat/embeddings/rerank, and a concurrent-connection bucket for streaming. All buckets draw from a small shared reserve when their local bucket is exhausted (soft-fail -> use reserve). Only hard-fail when both local+reserve are drained. That avoids immediate outages for bursty but important flows.

julian: implementation notes: token-bucket params per (org,key,endpoint). Keep traditional token fill rate per minute and max burst tokens. Shared_reserve is a separate bucket with configurable priority rules. pseudo-config idea: 
```
traffic_policy:
  per_key:
    endpoints:
      chat: { fill_per_min: 1_200_000, max_burst: 250_000 }
      embeddings: { fill_per_min: 500_000, max_burst: 100_000 }
      rerank: { fill_per_min: 250_000, max_burst: 60_000 }
  streaming:
    conn_limit_per_min: 600
    conn_burst: 60
  shared_reserve: { tokens: 150_000 }
  overflow_policy: \"priority: [rerank, chat, embeddings], preempt: false\"
```

sophia: overflow_policy here matters — rerank is latency sensitive and often low volume; prefer to prioritize rerank over embeddings during reserve depletion. Also add hysteresis: once reserve used, don't refill until average 5m usage < 60% to avoid oscillation.

matt: good call on hysteresis. For enforcement: could the runtime check endpoint label on request and debit the appropriate bucket atomically; if endpoint bucket empty try shared reserve; if both empty return 429 with structured body explaining exhausted buckets and next-available-ms. Also add a `x-quota-remaining` response header.

ops-bot: new metric created: `quota.debit.count` tagged by (org,key,endpoint,result) where result in {local,shared,blocked}. Metric emitted on every debit attempt.

arya: telemetry queries we should add to console: 
- per-key per-endpoint token consumption (last 1h, 24h)
- rate of reserve usage (count and fraction)
- average time-to-429 and top callers generating blocks
Example prom query: `sum(rate(quota_debit_tokens_total{endpoint=~\"chat|embeddings|rerank\"}[5m])) by (org,endpoint)`

julian: UX: in the Console -> Quotas page, show a stacked bar per org with endpoint buckets and reserve. Provide sliders to adjust fill rates and a toggle `enable shared_reserve` + `overflow_priority` selector. Also expose a per-key override modal. Any changes should be staged behind a rollout flag and only affect non-production keys initially.

matt: rollout plan suggestion: 1) implement scoring in runtime + metrics, 2) build consoles read-only views showing simulated per-key breakdown (no enforcement), 3) run a 2-week simulation comparing blocked vs simulated-blocked, 4) enable in canary region for 5% of keys with verbose logging, 5) ramp to 25/50/100. Provide automatic rollback if reserve usage spikes > 30% or 429s increase > 2x baseline.

sophia: one more internal API debate — do we unify per-endpoint buckets under a single `quota_v2` service or extend current quota service? I vote new `quota_v2` with clearer domain model (endpoint bucketing + reserve + hysteresis) to avoid disrupting old code.

matt: agree on quota_v2. ops: can you add alerting for reserve depletion & sudden 429 trend by endpoint? Also need tracing: annotate traces with `quota_source=local|shared|blocked`.

ops-bot: alert rule proposal pushed to infra repo: `Alert:QuotaReserveDepleted` fires when `sum(quota_debit_tokens_total{result=\"shared\"}[10m]) / sum(quota_debit_tokens_total{}[10m]) > 0.25`

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature branch `quota-v2-endpoint-buckets` will be deployed to canary on Monday 03:00 UTC.

arya: Any objections? If not I'll draft an RFC with the config schema, telemetry dashboard mocks, and the rollout checklist.

matt: please do. @sophia @julian lmk if you want to co-author. :thumbsup:

sophia: happy to help with console mocks.

julian: I'll take the runtime/atomic debit semantics section.

matt: thanks all — moving this to an RFC thread after lunch.
